note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. This engine's critical/low-grade detection is keyword-based (`categoryText` scans `cytologyResultCategory` + `reportingCategory`), not purely boolean-driven — wording matters, and 'malignancy' deliberately does NOT match the 'malignant' substring the high-grade detector looks for.

personas.name: normal-routine-cervical-screening-complete
personas.description: A normal routine cervical smear: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM), HPV negative, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.diagnosis: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
state.impression: Normal cervical cytology; HPV negative. Return to routine recall.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Routine recall in 3 years per the national screening programme.

personas.name: abnormal-isolated-hpv-positive-minor-complete
personas.description: Negative cytology (NILM) but HPV primary screening positive: an isolated HPV-positive result on otherwise normal cytology classifies as abnormal via the dedicated HPV-surveillance rule and grades minor severity, distinct from dysplasia-driven moderate severity; report complete — expect abnormal classification + minor severity + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up (early recall at 12 months).

state.recommendedFollowUp: Early recall for repeat HPV testing in 12 months.

personas.name: critical-high-grade-dyskaryosis-suspected-carcinoma-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: High-grade dyskaryosis, suspicious for invasive squamous cell carcinoma, with malignant cells confirmed on microscopy: this critical finding auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert, with the recommended action naming urgent colposcopy / MDT review; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated, no originating request is linked, and the clinical history, diagnosis, and impression sections are not yet completed while the referral is arranged — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.cytologyResultCategory: High-grade dyskaryosis, suspicious for invasive squamous cell carcinoma
state.microscopicDescription: Numerous malignant squamous cells with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, irregular nuclear contours, and abnormal mitoses, in keeping with invasive squamous cell carcinoma.
state.clinicianNotes: Phoned through to the referring team; urgent colposcopy and gynae-oncology MDT referral being arranged.

expected.recommendedAction: Communicate the critical result directly to the referrer now, document the conversation, and refer for urgent colposcopy / MDT review.
